mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.username FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, total_amount, status, pay_method, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{payMethod}, #{remark})
